headline: Google-area housing plan draws crowd at Mountain View study session
snippet: More than 80 residents spoke at a four-hour session on raising the North Bayshore housing cap. Transit capacity and school impacts were the most common concerns. DEMO STUB.

headline: El Camino businesses petition against Phase 2 bike lanes
snippet: A petition with 214 signatures asks the council to complete a parking study before removing spaces. Cycling advocates point to Phase 1 collision data. DEMO STUB.

headline: Rental Housing Committee weighs limits on capital improvement pass-throughs
snippet: Tenant advocates say pass-throughs are used to push out long-term renters; landlords say the cap would stall building upgrades. DEMO STUB.

headline: Parents pack school board meeting over possible campus consolidation
snippet: Enrollment has dropped 12% since 2021. Parents from Bubb and Theuerkauf urged the board to look at boundary changes before closing any campus. DEMO STUB.

headline: Shoreline bus lane: faster buses, slower cars, mixed reviews
snippet: Commuters split on the pilot as council prepares to vote on a 12-month extension. DEMO STUB.

headline: Chamber pushes back on business tax hike for homeless services
snippet: The proposed increase would raise $6.5M a year. Service providers say current funding meets about 40% of demand. DEMO STUB.
